raw: {"analysis":"ZLZ provides a more comprehensive plan that addresses all repository facts: it explicitly handles the flaky test by quarantining it, runs full regression in staging despite CI costs, requires dual team lead approval for staging, and SRE sign-off for production. ZLQ also covers most constraints but has a critical gap in its rollback strategy—it suggests immediate revert of the deployment artifact, which doesn't account for the irreversible schema migration already applied to production. ZLZ's rollback plan more accurately reflects that code rollback won't undo DB changes and properly keeps the polling fallback running.","verdict":"ZLZ"}
